scope: Native RAGTruth QA fit634 plus calibration159 only.

label_separation.initialize_link_materialize: Only label-free plans, layouts, white-box caches, and frozen NLI probabilities are opened.
label_separation.evaluate: Calibration annotations are opened once after fit_complete freezes candidate, model, and thresholds.
label_separation.official_test: No official-test path occurs in this module.

nli.coverage: Every exact frozen claim x source-sentence edge, not only claim-average top3.
nli.reuse: Reuse only bit-identical probabilities for the exact checkpoint/revision/premise/hypothesis request; ambiguous duplicates are recomputed.
nli.combination: For each token and layer, normalize all source-sentence attribution and take its weighted E/N/C average.

window_design.rows: Every unchanged eligible 4-raw-BPE stride-one window; short answers retain their original shorter window.
window_design.attribution: Mean and max over the lexical BPE rows touched by that exact window, retaining all 32x8 layer/features, plus lexical-token fraction.
window_design.fusion: Optionally append frozen window mean NLL and the clean fit-group-OOF/full-fit-cal Lookback and ModernBERT-large probabilities.

training.model: StandardScaler plus L2 liblinear logistic regression, fixed C=0.01
training.weights: Equal source-group mass, answer mass within group, and window mass within answer; then one fit-only binary-class balance and global scale.
training.selection: Fit OOF only: maximize min(window F1, answer F1), then window F1, answer F1, precision, then earlier candidate.
training.thresholds: Window and answer thresholds are chosen on fit OOF and frozen.

calibration: One strict evaluation with fit-frozen model and thresholds; no cal-F1Opt and no refit.
